title: factdiff.py detect run twice in one day overwrites the tracked detect log of that day
goal: factdiff.py detect writes a new log name (or appends) when kb/public/_census/factdiff-<date>.csv already exists, so a second detect run in one day never replaces a committed log; found 2026-11-09 when a refresh run had to restore the tracked log after a second detect overwrote it
repro_reason: needs a planted kb root with a tracked same-day log; the planner writes the real repro
